text:
Maria: heads-up: opened PR to split network module into network/vpc + network/peering. It's a small refactor but touches provider blocks and state paths. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234. Can folks sanity-check provider pin approach? cc @Jon @Aj
Jon: looking now. do we need a state mv?
Aj: probably. Are we keeping root provider or hoisting? I think hoist + explicit aliases. also what's lockfile plan?
Maria: Plan: 1) hoist providers to root module (remove duplicate provider blocks) 2) add version constraints in module registry blocks (e.g. ">= 3.0, < 4.0") 3) perform lockfile regen in a separate PR/CI job after state move. goal: avoid big churn in the split PR.
Sam: Suggest running `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` in a branch CI job and upload as artifact. we have an existing workflow: .github/workflows/tf-lock.yml — cc @Devops Bot can we reuse?
Devops Bot: CI: started run for branch maria/module-split (build #456). terraform validate passed. lockfile job queued.
Jon: Quick Q: if we hoist providers, do we need provider_alias for the peering module? it uses aws.account2 provider.
Aj: Yes, use provider 'aws.account2' with alias in module call. e.g.
```hcl
provider "aws" { alias = "account2" region = var.region_account2 }
module "peering" {
  source = "../network/peering"
  providers = { aws = aws.account2 }
}
```
Maria: Also FYI secrets: the module used to read secret path from var.secret_path. I'm changing to accept full arn and not read KMS. Will open follow-up to migrate secrets mapping in k8s manifest.
Sam: If you change var name, ensure terragrunt overlays and k8s helm values updated. I can grep and open follow-up PR for helm values.
Jon: LGTM on approach. One ask: don't regenerate lockfile in same PR — we've seen plan diffs explode. Instead: after merge, run lock regen PR and run smoke plan in staging.
Maria: :thumbsup: will update PR with a checklist and add a note to the PR body to hold lockfile regen. Also adding migration steps for state mv: include snippet below so reviewers can sanity-check.
```bash
# example state move for subnet resource
terraform state mv module.network.module.subnet.aws_subnet.this[0] module.vpc.module.subnet.aws_subnet.this[0]
# then run plan in staging workspace
terraform workspace select staging || terraform workspace new staging
terraform init && terraform plan -out=plan.tfout
```
Maria: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the canary branch into staging and run the canary plan.
Sam: I'll open the follow-up PR for helm values and the lockfile workflow reuse.
Aj: I'll review the state mv steps and test locally.
Jon: ping me if you want me to run the staging smoke plan.
Maria: will do — thanks everyone.:rocket:
